description: Parc de véhicules routiers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Service des données et études statistiques (SDES). The data provided concern the fleet of vehicles at municipal level, by engine, Crit'Air sticker, user status and type of vehicle, on 1 January of each year from 2011 until 2026. Coverage: Service des données et études statistiques (SDES). The portal shows the English title as "Road vehicle fleet" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Service des données et études statistiques (SDES). Its keywords include automobile, transport, vehicule, transports, circulation. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, PDF, CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
